invariants.name: Gateway is the only protected execution entry
invariants.assertion: A protected business side effect requires successful Secure Gateway admission.

invariants.name: Delegation monotonically attenuates
invariants.assertion: Every child capability, resource, constraint, quota, lifetime, and depth is no broader than its parent.

invariants.name: Every credential level enforces cumulative quota
invariants.assertion: Root, intermediate, and leaf reserved plus committed usage never exceeds each applicable limit.

invariants.name: Ancestor revocation propagates
invariants.assertion: A revoked ancestor prevents every descendant from receiving new protected admission.

invariants.name: One side effect per business idempotency key
invariants.assertion: A business idempotency key produces at most one protected business effect.

invariants.name: Requests are fresh and non-replayable
invariants.assertion: Duplicate request IDs and requests outside the freshness window cannot create a new effect.

invariants.name: Authorized parameters equal executed parameters
invariants.assertion: Protected tools execute only canonical parameters carried by the validated command and signed gateway envelope.

invariants.name: Decisions and effects have verifiable evidence
invariants.assertion: Parseable ALLOW and DENY decisions produce signed receipts; raw rejection produces a rejected audit event; all enter the audit chain.

invariants.name: Agents have no gateway bypass credential
invariants.assertion: Ordinary agents possess neither protected-tool internal credentials nor gateway, receipt, or audit signing keys.

invariants.name: Secrets and sensitive data are not logged in plaintext
invariants.assertion: Private keys, bearer tokens, full prompts, and sensitive customer content are excluded from logs.

invariants.name: One business action cannot replay with changed parameters
invariants.assertion: A reused business idempotency key with a different parameter hash is rejected as IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

invariants.name: Child credentials bind the actual signed parent
invariants.assertion: Every child contains and verifies both the parent credential ID and signed-object SM3 hash.

invariants.name: Protected tools trust only signed gateway commands
invariants.assertion: A protected tool requires a valid, purpose-bound GatewayExecutionEnvelope.

invariants.name: Gateway-to-tool commands are non-replayable
invariants.assertion: An execution attempt ID is accepted once and an expired envelope is never executed.

invariants.name: Result retrieval reauthorizes
invariants.assertion: Result and receipt retrieval recheck current chain, key, revocation, tenant, task, freshness, and replay without execution or reservation.

invariants.name: LLM cannot choose business action identity
invariants.assertion: A trusted business action policy and registry create or resolve side-effect action identity and trusted action slots.
